messages.subject: ERROR: cannot open the connection
parts:
This must be an easy fix....but I am stymied. I set up my RStudio shiny server account yesterday. Here were the verbatim instructions I received:
 
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
To host Shiny applications, create a directory called ~/ShinyApps/. Put
your Shiny application directories directly under there and they will
become available automatically. For example, ~/ShinyApps/myapp/ would be
accessible at http://spark.rstudio.com/rcourses/myapp/.
If your Shiny application has package dependencies, simply install them
as usual using RStudio Server (or ssh in and use R from the command line).
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
So in the Shiny Server app, I created a folder "ShinyApps" and then underneath that one, created a folder "pls" and put my working ui.R and server.R and other files in there.
 
so the directory is spark.rstudio.com/rcourses/ShinyApps/pls
 
My user name is "rcourses"
 
When I open a web browser and point it to: http://spark.rstudio.com/rcourses/pls
 
I get the error in the webpage: "ERROR: cannot open the connection"
 
and yet it seems that I can view any other example that is hosted on Spark with no problem at all ! !
 
What am I doing wrong, please?
 
pls-man

messages.subject: Re: ERROR: cannot open the connection

and when I put my shiny app ui.R and server.R files directly under the ShinyApps directory and try to access it in a browser on a different machine at http://spark.rstudio.com/rcourses (my root for my shiny apps), the web page returns the message
 
Page not found
 
Sorry, but the page you requested doesn't exist
 
Is there something wrong with my new account? I logged in yesterday for the first time, was immediately able to use Shiny Server, set up the directories, upload all my files.....but it seems that my initialized account under the user name 'rcourses' simply cannot be viewed from the outside......
 
I followed the instructions verbatim, copying and pasting all of the commands directly from the instructions.....everything looks fine to me.....but the app, or even the pages, are simply not viewable "from the outside"
 
Please Help !
 
pls-man

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: ERROR: cannot open the connection
parts:
With Shiny Server, you should put the apps in a directory like /home/username/ShinyApps/myapp  (In the instructions, the ~ stands for /home/username.)
Then you should be able to visit it with a web browser at:
http://spark.rstudio.com/username/myapp/

runApp() is really only for local development, and it won't work properly on Glimmer and Spark.

-Winston

By default, when you log in with RStudio Server, it starts in your home directory, which is /home/rcourses, so you need only to make a ShinyApps directory under that. I went ahead and created the directory /home/rcourses/ShinyApps/01_hello, and copied over the example 01_hello app. You can visit it at:
http://spark.rstudio.com/rcourses/01_hello/

Best,
-Winston
